fit_ridge_regression: fit a Ridge regression model with L2 regularization to predict continuous target values
solve_ridge_equation: solve the ridge regression equation using cholesky, svd, lsqr, or sparse_cg solvers
select_optimal_alpha: select the optimal regularization alpha using leave-one-out cross-validation with RidgeCV
classify_with_ridge: classify samples using RidgeClassifier that converts targets to {-1, 1} and fits a regression model
enforce_positive_coefs: enforce positive coefficients in ridge regression using the lbfgs solver with positive=True
